enabled.description: Whether the whole surface is live. false makes every other field inert — a body's attach/detach/reel channels (even if separately declared and bound) never reach the attachment state machine.

grappleMaxDistance.description: The non-negative world-unit ceiling a grapple aim searches along the body's facing direction — also the tether's rope length at attach (the resolved anchor's actual distance, always within this ceiling).

grappleAssistHalfAngleDegrees.description: The non-negative aim-assist cone half-angle, degrees, a grapple candidate's bearing must fall within around the body's facing.

reelRate.description: The non-negative world-units-per-second the held ReelChannel reels the rope at — positive reels out, negative in (the channel's own sign selects direction; this is a magnitude).

reelInFloor.description: The non-negative rope-length floor a reel-in clamps to.

releaseMomentumScale.description: The non-negative multiplier detach applies to the body's velocity at the instant of release — 1 preserves it exactly, below 1 dampens, above 1 boosts.

attachChannel.description: The declared channel name (validated) whose rising edge throws the grapple. null leaves attach unreachable from any channel.

detachChannel.description: The declared channel name (validated) whose rising edge clears an active tether. null leaves detach unreachable from any channel.

reelChannel.description: The declared channel name (validated) whose held bipolar value drives the grapple rope length every tick. null leaves reel inert.
